title: scrape.raw
description: Phase 4.1: raw bytes captured from a source. Mirrors `ai/swarm/agents/payloads.py::ScrapeRaw`. Either `bytes_b64` (inline) or `bytes_ref` (content-addressed key) carries the body; `bytes_sha256` is always populated.

bytes_b64.description: Base64 of the response body. Empty when `bytes_ref` is used.

bytes_ref.description: Content-addressed object-store key. Empty for inline payloads.

wire_bytes.description: Optional: bytes on the wire (post-compression). 0 = unknown. Phase 7 §7.2 inflate-ratio detector skips when zero.

decoded_bytes.description: Optional: bytes after gzip/brotli inflate. 0 = unknown. Phase 7 §7.2 inflate-ratio detector skips when zero.
